events.headline: Boeing finalizes order for up to 150 737 MAX jets from Turkish Airlines
events.summary: Turkish Airlines committed to 100 737-8 aircraft plus options for 50 more, making it the airline's largest Boeing single-aisle order and adding substantial commercial backlog.

events.headline: Biman Bangladesh Airlines orders 11 Boeing aircraft
events.summary: The national carrier ordered five 787-10s and six 737-8s, expanding Boeing's order book with Biman to 25 aircraft and supporting commercial-aircraft demand.

events.headline: FAA delays 737 MAX 10 certification over software issue
events.summary: The FAA paused certification of Boeing's long-delayed 737 MAX 10 while a software issue affecting automated flight guidance during a specific go-around scenario was resolved, creating a timing and delivery risk.

events.headline: U.S. Navy selects Boeing for F/A-XX sixth-generation fighter program
events.summary: The Navy awarded Boeing a multi-billion-dollar contract to design, build and deliver its F/A-XX aircraft, adding a major defense program intended to replace F/A-18 Super Hornets.

events.headline: Ethiopian Airlines orders 10 Boeing freighters
events.summary: Ethiopian Airlines placed a firm order for eight 777-8 Freighters and two 777 Freighters, making it the first African carrier to order the 777-8F and strengthening Boeing's widebody backlog.

events.headline: Boeing receives approximately $14.7 billion PAC-3 MSE seeker contract
events.summary: Lockheed Martin awarded Boeing an undefinitized contract action under a seven-year framework to triple PAC-3 MSE seeker production, with hundreds of related jobs expected in Huntsville.

events.headline: FAA certifies Boeing 737-10
events.summary: FAA approval of the 737-10's amended type certificate clears Boeing to begin deliveries in the coming months; Boeing said more than 30 customers had ordered 1,555 of the model.
